notes: Original indexed Wowhead Looter community item-side cumulative disenchanting table, observed 2026-11-08. Input item 229336 (Epic priest cloth feet (11.1.0 Undermine)) reports 122 disenchants. Material row 1/3 records 59 occurrences in that SAME original cohort. Other material rows, bonus variants and PTR mirrors are not independent studies. Output quality-rank identity is unknown: the indexed table omits the distinct Refulgent Crystal item hyperlinks, so do not assign 219952/219954/219955 by displayed row order. Source provides no verified completed-cast per-material unit totals, min/max, no-drop count, 0..N histogram, character skill/spec, per-de item-level/bonus, Resourcefulness/refund accounting or sample patch date; keep null. These cumulative item-side data span unreported player skill, item bonus and build variations; do not use as verified current skill/rank-specific rate.
